### MS-GLUTAMATE META-ANALYSIS: STEP 1 ###

"Brain glutamate, disease burden, and neuropsychiatric symptoms in multiple sclerosis: a meta-analysis"


This is the first script (out of two), to run the statistical analyses for the ms-glutamate meta-analysis project. This script runs the meta-analysis of all metabolites combined, as well separated by glutamate and glutamate+glutamine (referred to as glx throughout the script). 

Pre: 
- Update base_dir to your own local environment. 
- Ensure that all packages (listed in stage 1: setup chunk) have been previously downloaded.
- Have the extraction data "msglu_metaanalysis_extracted_data" downloaded and loaded into the appropriate folder.
  - Data can be found on the github: ms_glutamate_metaanalysis/data/msglu_metaanalysis_extracted_data.xlsx
  
Post:
- Meta-analysis results for all metabolites combined, glutamate, and glutamate+glutamine, to be used in script 2.

<https://bookdown.org/MathiasHarrer/Doing_Meta_Analysis_in_R/> Citation:
Harrer, M., Cuijpers, P., Furukawa, T.A., & Ebert, D.D. (2021). Doing Meta-Analysis with R: A Hands-On Guide. Boca Raton, FL and London: Chapman & Hall/CRC Press. ISBN 978-0-367-61007-4.


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Stage 1: Set up packages and paths
#### Setup
```{r setup-packages}
# Set paths
base_dir   <- "/Users/elenacooper/Desktop/MS_Meta_Analysis" # update this path to reflect your local environment
results_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "final_results")

# Load packages
load_packages <- function(packages) {
  for (pkg in packages) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
      install.packages(pkg)
    }
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

packages_needed <- c(
  "readxl", "writexl", "tidyverse", "grid", "gridExtra",
  "ggpattern", "knitr", "esc", "metafor", "meta", "dmetar", "DeLuciatoR", "RColorBrewer"
)
load_packages(packages_needed)

```

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Stage 2: Calculate effect sizes and run overall meta-analysis - If already calculated, SKIP to Stage 3 (Next script)
Citations:
<https://bookdown.org/MathiasHarrer/Doing_Meta_Analysis_in_R/effectsizecalculator.html>
<https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/esc/versions/0.5.1/topics/effect_sizes>

### Import Data
```{r}
# All studies
dataset_all <- read_excel(paste0(base_dir, "/Extraction/data/msglu_metaanalysis_extracted_data.xlsx")) 

# Only studies that report T-stats
datasetT <- read_excel(paste0(base_dir, "/Extraction/data/msglu_metaanalysis_extracted_data.xlsx"), 2) 

# Only studies that report P-Values
datasetP <- read_excel(paste0(base_dir, "/Extraction/data/msglu_metaanalysis_extracted_data.xlsx"), 3) 

```

### Reformat dataframes
```{r}
# Delete empty rows
clean_empty_rows <- function(df) {
  df <- df[!apply(is.na(df) | df == "", 1, all), ] 
}
dataset_all <- clean_empty_rows(dataset_all)
datasetT <- clean_empty_rows(datasetT)
datasetP <- clean_empty_rows(datasetP)

# Select and convert columns to numeric
num_cols <- c(
  "Case_Mean", "Case_Std_Dev", "Case_Sex_F_n", "Control_Mean", "Control_Std_Dev", "Control_Sex_F_n", "Sex_%F", "Total_n_of_participants",
  "EDSS_mean", "Mean_Disease_duration","Disease_duration_SD", "Mean_Case_Age", "Mean_Control_Age", "Echo_Time", "Repetition_Time",
  "GM_Tissue_case_mean_pct", "GM_Tissue_case_SD_pct", "GM_Tissue_control_mean_pct", "GM_Tissue_control_SD_pct", "Med_Naive_Percent",
  "WM_Tissue_case_mean_pct", "WM_Tissue_case_SD_pct", "WM_Tissue_control_mean_pct", "WM_Tissue_control_SD_pct", "CSF_case_mean_pct",
  "CSF_case_SD_pct", "CSF_control_mean_pct", "CSF_control_SD_pct", "Mean_CRLB_Case_pct", "SD_CRLB_Case_pct", "Mean_CRLB_Control_pct",
  "SD_CRLB_Control_pct", "CRLB_Thresh_pct", "Combined_Age_Mean", "Combined_Age_SD", "Case_Sex_%F", "Control_Sex_%F", 
  "Percent_Med_at_Scan", "EDSS_median", "EDSS_min", "EDSS_max", "EDSS_sd", "Case_Sample_size", "Control_Sample_size"
)

dataset_all[num_cols] <- lapply(dataset_all[num_cols], as.numeric)

# Create datasetM for studies with Means & SDs
datasetM <- dataset_all %>%
  filter(str_detect(stat_reported, regex("sd", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  select(Study_ID, Study, Case_Mean, Case_Std_Dev, Case_Sample_size, Control_Mean, Control_Std_Dev, Control_Sample_size)

# Rename columns to match metafor package
names(datasetM)[3:8] <- c("Me", "Se", "Ne", "Mc", "Sc", "Nc")

# Format T and P statistic datasets
names(datasetT)[3:4] <- c("NeT", "NcT")
names(datasetP)[3:4] <- c("NeP", "NcP")

# Format p-values
datasetP <- datasetP %>%
  mutate(
    P_value = gsub("NS", "0.2", P_value) 
  )

datasetP <- datasetP %>%
  mutate(
    P_value = gsub("P<0.05", "0.05", P_value),
    P_value = gsub("P<0.01", "0.01", P_value),
    P_value = gsub("P<0.001", "0.001", P_value))

datasetP <- datasetP %>%
  mutate(
P_value = as.numeric(P_value))

# Format additional variables 
dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(
    Med_Naive_YN = case_when(
      Med_Naive_YN == "N" ~ "Not Med Naive",
      Med_Naive_YN == "Y" ~ "Med Naive",
      TRUE ~ Med_Naive_YN
    ),
    DMT = case_when(
      DMT == "N" ~ "Not on DMT",
      DMT == "Y" ~ "On DMT",
      TRUE ~ DMT
    )
  )

```

### Calculate Effect Sizes
#### Effect direction
```{r}
dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(
    # Only calculate if the row has Mean/SD data
    is_mean_sd = str_detect(stat_reported, regex("sd", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    
    # Difference in Means (Case - Control)
    `Difference in means` = if_else(is_mean_sd, 
                                    Case_Mean - Control_Mean, 
                                    NA_real_),
    
    # Effect Direction (1 for Case > Control, 0 otherwise)
    `Effect Direction (case - control)` = if_else(`Difference in means` > 0, 1, 0),
    
    # Standard Error of the Difference
    `DiM Std Err` = if_else(is_mean_sd,
                            sqrt((Case_Std_Dev^2 / Case_Sample_size) + (Control_Std_Dev^2 / Control_Sample_size)), 
                            NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(-is_mean_sd) 

```

#### Means and Standard Deviations (case - control) Effect Sizes
```{r}
# Calculate the Effect Sizes
effect_size_results <- effect_sizes(datasetM, 
                                    study = Study, 
                                    grp1m = Me, 
                                    grp1sd = Se, 
                                    grp1n = Ne, 
                                    grp2m = Mc, 
                                    grp2sd = Sc, 
                                    grp2n = Nc, 
                                    fun = "esc_mean_sd", 
                                    es.type = "d") 

effect_size_clean <- effect_size_results %>%
  select(study, es, se) %>%
  rename(Study = study, SDM = es, `SDM Std Err` = se)

dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  left_join(effect_size_clean, by = "Study")

```

#### T-Statistics case - control, effect size + when case > control
```{r}
# Calculate Effect Sizes from T-statistics
effect_size_t <- effect_sizes(datasetT, 
                              study = Study, 
                              grp1n = NeT, 
                              grp2n = NcT, 
                              t = T_value, 
                              fun = "esc_t", 
                              es.type = "d")

effect_size_t_clean <- effect_size_t %>%
  select(study, es, se) %>%
  rename(Study = study, SDM_t = es, SE_t = se)

dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  left_join(effect_size_t_clean, by = "Study") %>%
  mutate(
    # If SDM is NA, replace it with the T-statistic result
    SDM = coalesce(SDM, SDM_t),
    `SDM Std Err` = coalesce(`SDM Std Err`, SE_t)
  ) %>%
  select(-SDM_t, -SE_t)

# Effect Direction (1 = Case > Control)
dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(
    `Effect Direction (case - control)` = case_when(
      !is.na(T_value) & T_value > 0 ~ 1,
      !is.na(T_value) & T_value <= 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ `Effect Direction (case - control)`
    )
  )

```

#### P-Values Effect Sizes
```{r}
# Calculate Effect Size from P-values
effect_size_p <- effect_sizes(datasetP, 
                              study = Study, 
                              grp1n = NeP, 
                              grp2n = NcP, 
                              p = P_value, 
                              fun = "esc_t", 
                              es.type = "d")

effect_size_p_clean <- effect_size_p %>%
  rename(Study = study) %>%
  left_join(datasetP %>% select(Study, P_value_effect_direction), by = "Study") %>%
  mutate(
    # Force negative if Control > Case, otherwise keep positive
    es = if_else(P_value_effect_direction == "Control_greater_than_case", -abs(es), abs(es))
  ) %>%
  select(Study, es, se) %>%
  rename(SDM_p = es, SE_p = se)

dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  left_join(effect_size_p_clean, by = "Study") %>%
  mutate(
    SDM = coalesce(SDM, SDM_p),
    `SDM Std Err` = coalesce(`SDM Std Err`, SE_p)
  ) %>%
  select(-SDM_p, -SE_p)

# Effect Direction (1 = Case > Control)
dataset_all <- dataset_all %>%
  mutate(
    `Effect Direction (case - control)` = case_when(
      !is.na(P_value_effect_direction) & P_value_effect_direction == "Control_greater_than_case" ~ 0,
      !is.na(P_value_effect_direction) & P_value_effect_direction != "Control_greater_than_case" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ `Effect Direction (case - control)`
    )
  )

```

### Overall Meta-Analysis 
```{r}
####### OVERALL META-ANALYSIS ####### 

# Clean dataset in accordance with the final inclusion and exclusion criteria
dataset <- dataset_all %>%
  filter(Use_in_analysis == "Y") %>%
  filter(Sequence_MRSQ_Grouping != "EPSI_3D") %>%
  filter(Imputed == "N")

meta_overall <- metagen(
    TE = SDM,             
    seTE = `SDM Std Err`, 
    data = dataset, 
    studlab = Study,
    common = FALSE,        
    random = TRUE,
    method.tau = "DL",     
    method.random.ci = "classic",
    prediction = TRUE,
    sm = "SMD"
)

if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE)

saveRDS(meta_overall, file = file.path(results_dir, "meta_OVERALL_all_metabolites.rds"))

# Create function for meta results 
run_and_annotate <- function(data, metabolite_name, results_dir) {
  subset_data <- dataset %>% filter(Neurometabolite_Type == metabolite_name) 
  
  if(nrow(subset_data) < 3) {
    message(paste("Skipping", metabolite_name, "- need at least 3 studies"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  meta_result <- metagen(
    TE = SDM, seTE = `SDM Std Err`, data = subset_data, studlab = Study,
    common = FALSE, random = TRUE, method.tau = "DL", 
    method.random.ci = "classic", prediction = TRUE, sm = "SMD"
  )
  
  saveRDS(meta_result, file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("meta_", metabolite_name, ".rds")))
  return(subset_data)
}

write_xlsx(dataset, path = file.path(results_dir, "DATASET_all_metabolites.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)

##### METABOLITE-SPECIFIC META-ANALYSIS ######

# Glutamate
dataset_glu <- run_and_annotate(dataset, "Glu", results_dir)

# Glutamate+Glutamine
dataset_glx <- run_and_annotate(dataset, "Glx", results_dir)

# All summaries
message("--- OVERALL RESULTS (All 'Y' Metabolites) ---")
summary(meta_overall)

message("--- INDIVIDUAL Glu RESULTS ---")
summary(readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "meta_Glu.rds")))

# Save excel to use in the next script
write_xlsx(dataset_glu, path = file.path(results_dir, "DATASET_Glu.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)
write_xlsx(dataset_glx, path = file.path(results_dir, "DATASET_Glx.xlsx"), col_names = TRUE, format_headers = TRUE)

```
